scope: Twelve core reference inputs only; this is NOT approval of any generated runtime model.
visualReview: Each generated triptych was inspected for complete front/right/back, shared regional materials and distinct progression; all family levels were compared after the set was complete.

notes.palette: Rounded grey stone lower walls, cream plaster, brown exposed timber, orange-red tile roofs and teal shutters remain coherent with the reused Alpine chalet input.
notes.levels: One/two/three inhabited floor tiers are represented. villa_3 and shop_3 required explicit side-elevation corrections so their top floors are visible in all three views rather than merely adding a front attic opening.
notes.families: Villas have broad domestic timber gables and modest balconies; bakery shops have glazed displays and orange-striped awnings; inns have independent timber entrance porches and broad guest-room balconies; residences grow into narrower, taller cream wall bodies with stone corner piers and vertically aligned arched openings.
notes.reconstructionRisk: Porch side gaps and balcony railings remain reconstruction-sensitive; inspect native model silhouettes and solid walls rather than accepting the reference status as model approval.
